name: funm
expr: Fe = funm(A, @exp); Fs = funm(A, @sin); Fc = funm(A, @cos); Ge = funm(S, @exp);
comment: Sig: F = funm(A, fun). General matrix function (scalar fun OF a matrix, not element-wise) via eigendecomposition: F = V*diag(fun(diag(D)))/V where [V,D]=eig(A); real(F) for real A. Covered branches: diagonalizable non-symmetric matrix with @exp/@sin/@cos, symmetric matrix with @exp. NOTE: MATLAB funm calls feval(fun,x,k) with a derivative-order arg on its generic path, so @sqrt/anonymous funcs error in MATLAB but work here; parity only uses the special funcs (exp/sin/cos) MATLAB funm accepts directly. DEFERRED branch: complex-eigenvalue and defective (repeated-eigenvalue) matrices error — numkit eig [V,D] needs Francis QR (separate deferred limitation), documented in bugs/linalg/funm.md. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes bugs/linalg/funm.md.
